reason_for_change: Two-mana instant copies the next instant/sorcery spell cast that turn; flashback grants a second use; can copy Brain Freeze, a ritual or tutor.
commander_identity_rationale: Directly supports Cormela's instant/sorcery engine and graveyard recursion.
role_impact: Adds copy flexibility; loses Grapeshot damage/removal; Brain Freeze and Tendrils remain.
power_level_impact: Qualitative cEDH combo support; no win-rate claim.
oracle_rules_verification: Copy is not cast and does not increment storm. Flashback exiles it after resolution; Cormela can return it only if it remains in graveyard as the death trigger resolves.

reason_for_change: Brain Freeze and Tendrils remain distinct storm finishers; creates room for more flexible spell copying.
role_impact: Loses one-mana direct damage/utility creature removal.
power_level_impact: Meta-sensitive; retain Grapeshot if its removal/damage is more important.
oracle_rules_verification: Grapeshot deals 1 damage to target and has storm.
